method.en: Actual source-year polygons plus independently bounded political and cultural context intervals. Names and outlines remain dated; later outlines are used only when backward review is explicit. A culture is not presented as a sovereign state.
method.zh: 使用真实来源年份的图形，并分别复核政治与文化背景的适用时段。名称和轮廓保留日期；只有明确复核后才可参考较晚轮廓。文化区域不视为主权国家。

exclusions.name: Egypt
exclusions.reason: Upstream polygon extends far into Nubia; the same outline recurs at 2000 BCE. Early dynastic political control was not established for that footprint.

exclusions.name: Kingdom of David and Solomon
exclusions.reason: Chronologically incompatible with the snapshot, already documented in the first-release audit.

exclusions.name: Roman Empire
exclusions.reason: Source includes an eastern extension toward southern Mesopotamia characteristic of disputed/temporary conquests; omitted pending a dated frontier reconstruction.

exclusions.name: Empire of Ghana
exclusions.reason: Early chronology and source footprint not secure enough for inclusion.

exclusions.name: Mali
exclusions.reason: Mali Empire chronology begins in the thirteenth century; this small earlier region is not treated as the empire.

exclusions.name: Fatimid Caliphate
exclusions.reason: Fatimid rule ended in 1171.

exclusions.name: Ghaznavid Emirate
exclusions.reason: Ghaznavid rule ended in 1186.

exclusions.name: Mongol Empire
exclusions.reason: The Mongol imperial foundation is conventionally dated 1206; cannot be shown as a unified empire in 1200.

exclusions.name: Song Empire
exclusions.reason: Geometry repeats the 1000 Northern Song footprint and fails to distinguish Southern Song from Jin.

exclusions.name: Sultanate of Delhi
exclusions.reason: The sultanate was founded in 1206; the 1200 label is premature.

exclusions.name: Chola Empire
exclusions.reason: Source repeats the 1000 outline, including Sri Lankan territory not supported for 1200.

exclusions.name: Byzantine Empire
exclusions.reason: Source retains extensive eastern/central Anatolia and southern Italian territory inconsistent with the twelfth-century losses; omitted pending a better dated source.

exclusions.name: Chola Empire
exclusions.reason: The major Chola imperial period ended before this snapshot.

exclusions.name: Great Khanate
exclusions.reason: Source repeats the Yuan-era outline after the establishment of the Ming in 1368.

exclusions.name: Shogun Japan (Kamakura)
exclusions.reason: Kamakura rule ended in 1333; do not cosmetically relabel an unreviewed footprint.

exclusions.name: Inca Empire
exclusions.reason: The source preserves a preconquest footprint long after the Spanish conquest and the end of the Vilcabamba state.

exclusions.name: Songhai
exclusions.reason: The source does not adequately represent the consequences of the 1591 Moroccan invasion.

exclusions.name: Ming Chinese Empire
exclusions.reason: Source extends much farther into northeast Asia than the selected 1500 outline; effective control and claimed jurisdictions are not distinguished.

exclusions.name: United States of America
exclusions.reason: The source appears to include Florida before its 1821 transfer and is omitted.

exclusions.name: Austrian Empire
exclusions.reason: That title dates from 1804; Habsburg lands should not be automatically relabeled without review.

exclusions.name: Spain (Caribbean feature)
exclusions.reason: Source still assigns Cuba and Puerto Rico to Spain after 1898.

exclusions.name: Kingdom of Hawaii
exclusions.reason: Hawaii was annexed by the United States in 1898; source authority is stale.

exclusions.name: Kingdom of Brazil
exclusions.reason: Brazil became a republic in 1889; no unreviewed relabeling performed.

exclusions.name: Zambia, Malawi, Tanzania, Zimbabwe
exclusions.reason: Stale or premature sovereign-authority fields; source requires dated colonial and independence review.

exclusions.name: Egypt and Syria as separate authorities
exclusions.reason: They formed the United Arab Republic in 1958–1961; not included as separate independent countries.

exclusions.name: China / Tibet
exclusions.reason: Separate source features require a specific historical control/dispute model that this layer does not supply.

exclusions.name: Indonesia
exclusions.reason: West New Guinea status needs separate review; omitted rather than using a modern national silhouette.

exclusions.name: Jiangshan s_ming_a0 main Ming outline
exclusions.reason: Although the phase is labelled 1388–1407, the geometry retains the same far-northeastern envelope as the source's Yongle expansion phase (141.26 E, 56.87 N). Omitted instead of treating the phase caption as proof of territorial accuracy.
The source incorrectly retains Upper Peru/Charcas (including Sucre and La Paz) within Peru after the 1776 creation of Río de la Plata. Removed rather than redrawn without a dated replacement.
The source omits Upper Peru/Charcas transferred to Río de la Plata in 1776. Removed together with the conflicting Peru outline.
The source omits Harar far beyond the coarse outline despite incorporation into Ethiopia in 1887. Removed until a better dated geometry is sourced.

exclusions.name: Serbia and Montenegro as separate sovereign authorities
exclusions.reason: The source labels both as separate authorities before the 2006 dissolution of their federation. They are not silently relabeled or merged.

exclusions.name: Timor-Leste / East Timor
exclusions.reason: No named, separately reviewed polygon in the source snapshot; no modern polygon is backdated. Transition is covered in sourced historical entries.

exclusions.name: Other unselected source entities
exclusions.reason: This pass reviews the named selected set; remaining upstream features are not assumed correct merely because they have a dated filename.

exclusions.name: Serbia and Montenegro as separate sovereign authorities
exclusions.reason: The source labels both as separate authorities before the 2006 dissolution of their federation. They are not silently relabeled or merged.

exclusions.name: Hong Kong
exclusions.reason: Source still gives the United Kingdom as authority after the 1997 handover.

exclusions.name: Zaire
exclusions.reason: Source retains the former state name after its 1997 change to Democratic Republic of the Congo. Geometry not adopted without a fuller authority review.

exclusions.name: Timor-Leste / East Timor
exclusions.reason: No named, separately reviewed polygon in the source snapshot; no modern polygon is backdated. Transition is covered in sourced historical entries.

exclusions.name: Other unselected source entities
exclusions.reason: This pass reviews the named selected set; remaining upstream features are not assumed correct merely because they have a dated filename.

exclusions.name: Serbia / Kosovo
exclusions.reason: Source has no separate reviewed Kosovo control/status model for 2010. Omitted pending a model that distinguishes sovereignty claims and administration.

exclusions.name: Zaire
exclusions.reason: Source retains the former state name after its 1997 change to Democratic Republic of the Congo. Geometry not adopted without a fuller authority review.

exclusions.name: Timor-Leste / East Timor
exclusions.reason: No named, separately reviewed polygon in the source snapshot; no modern polygon is backdated. Transition is covered in sourced historical entries.

exclusions.name: Other unselected source entities
exclusions.reason: This pass reviews the named selected set; remaining upstream features are not assumed correct merely because they have a dated filename.

exclusions.name: Egypt / Elam / Ur
exclusions.reason: The Egyptian outline extends into Kerma; Elam misses Susa; Ur is given a regional kingdom outline inappropriate to the stated early date. None is relabelled into a verified early state.

exclusions.name: Egypt / Elam / Hittites / Ur
exclusions.reason: Egypt repeats the overextended Nubian outline; Elam misses Susa; Hittite political chronology is premature; Ur III ends before this source year.

exclusions.name: David and Solomon / Zhoa / Sinic / Urartu
exclusions.reason: Anachronistic state labels or broad ethnic regions cannot be silently converted into contemporaneous states.

exclusions.name: Hittites
exclusions.reason: The upstream imperial shape survives after the Bronze Age Hittite kingdom collapsed.

exclusions.name: Mauryan Empire
exclusions.reason: The source preserves a Mauryan label after the dynasty ended.

exclusions.name: Parthian Empire / Gupta Empire / Roman ruler labels
exclusions.reason: Parthia survives after 224 and Gupta imperial chronology is premature; Roman ruler labels do not reliably match 300.

exclusions.name: Gupta Empire
exclusions.reason: Source footprint reaches deep into peninsular India; imperial administration and cultural influence are not distinguished.

exclusions.name: Western Roman Empire / Jin Empire / Tuʻi Tonga
exclusions.reason: These labels are incompatible with the stated year or unsupported political phases.

exclusions.name: Sui / Sasanian / Umayyad Caliphate
exclusions.reason: Sui and Sasanian names persist after their dynasties; the Umayyad polygon includes Iberia before 711 and omits eastern regions. No source-year correction is invented.

exclusions.name: Carolingian Empire / Tibetan Empire
exclusions.reason: Do not retain undivided imperial labels after fragmentation. East and West Francia are selected separately.

exclusions.name: Byzantine / Fatimid / Sukhothai / Wari
exclusions.reason: Byzantine and Fatimid outlines retain major earlier possessions; Sukhothai is premature, and Wari imperial chronology is insecure.

exclusions.name: Manchu Empire / Dutch Brazil / Dutch Formosa
exclusions.reason: Source repeats an incomplete 1650 Qing footprint and obsolete Dutch colonial possessions. Use separately dated 1715 Qing reference with explicit review window.

exclusions.name: United States
exclusions.reason: The source includes Florida before its 1821 transfer; excluded, as are 1800/1815 repetitions.

exclusions.name: United States / New Granada / Peru
exclusions.reason: USA includes Florida prematurely; South American viceroyalty outlines require separate revolutionary-war and Upper Peru review.

exclusions.name: Manchu Empire
exclusions.reason: The source retains Qing/Manchu state identity after the 1911–1912 revolution.

exclusions.name: USSR / modern colonial-state authorities
exclusions.reason: USSR label precedes its 1922 formation; numerous future independent states are incorrectly present in the source.

exclusions.name: United Kingdom
exclusions.reason: The source still includes the Irish Free State inside the UK. Use 1920 only through 1922, and the correctly separated 1938 UK/Ireland outlines from 1923 with explicit backward review.

exclusions.name: White Russia / Far Eastern SSR / missing main USSR
exclusions.reason: The file retains expired Russian civil-war entities and lacks a coherent main Soviet outline.1938 geometry is an explicitly dated reference only within its reviewed Soviet phase.

exclusions.name: Cochin China under Japan / Israel / obsolete Arabian emirates
exclusions.reason: These source labels/authorities are chronologically unsupported for 1938.

exclusions.name: Pakistan / Bangladesh / United Arab Emirates / many future colonial states
exclusions.reason: Independent-state identities appear prematurely in the upstream file; excluded.

exclusions.name: Vietnam / Indonesia / Egypt–Syria / premature African independence
exclusions.reason: A single Vietnam outline conceals division; West New Guinea needs separate review; Egypt/Syria are then UAR; numerous African names/authorities are premature.

exclusions.name: Tibet as a separate sovereign feature
exclusions.reason: The upstream source classification is not adopted. The PRC feature is explicitly a partial source core, with missing Tibet geometry disclosed; no union or frontier is fabricated.

selectionPolicy: Newest eligible prior source per polity, inside an explicit inclusive contextValidity interval; otherwise earliest explicitly backward-reviewed source. Missing metadata means exact source year only. Original source years and licenses are preserved; never interpolate borders or extend expired identities.

contextSchema.bounds: inclusive civil years; no year zero
contextSchema.sourceYear: the original dated outline; unchanged when rendered in another year
contextSchema.backwardReviewed: a future-dated outline is eligible only when true and the selected year is in the stated interval
contextSchema.selection: one newest eligible prior source per polityId, otherwise earliest explicitly reviewed future source

regionalContinuityReview.method: Additive dated context; no annual border interpolation
